title: Current-mirror differential-pair bias
goal: A reader must be able to trace the diode-connected NPN current mirror into the common tail of a loaded differential pair.

rubric.must: Q1 and Q2 are both labelled 2N3904 and visibly share one base node labelled BBASE.
Q1 has its collector visibly tied to its base, with RREF leading from VCC into that node.
Q2’s collector connects to the single TAIL node shared by the emitters of Q3 and Q4.
VIN+ and VIN− feed separate bases of the two differential-pair transistors.
Each differential-pair collector has its own 2.2 kΩ load resistor to VCC.
The diagram visibly labels a 5 V VCC supply and a 4.3 kΩ, 1% reference resistor.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the circuit exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: Codex visual recheck: R2/RC1 and R3/RC2 are correctly labelled 2.2 kΩ; Q1 has its collector tied to the shared BASE node, Q2 connects to TAIL, and the two separate signal inputs cross TAIL with a visible non-junction bridge. The first judge’s rejection contradicted its own all-pass rubric and final acceptance sentence.

items.evidence: Q1 and Q2 are labeled 2N3904, with both bases connected to the shared node labeled BBASE.
Q1’s collector loops back to its BBASE node, and R1 · RREF runs from VCC into that node.
Q2’s collector joins the TAIL node, which visibly connects to the emitters of Q3 and Q4.
VIN+ connects to Q3’s base and VIN− connects separately to Q4’s base.
Q3 and Q4 each have a separate 2.2 kΩ resistor to VCC, labeled R2 · RC1 and R3 · RC2 respectively.
VCC is labeled +5 V; RREF is labeled 4.3 kΩ, 1%.
